item.title: ‘Dewey Defeats Truman’: The True Story Behind One Of American History’s Most Iconic Images
item.description: The editors of the Chicago Daily Tribune were so sure that New York Governor Thomas E. Dewey was going to win the presidential election of 1948 that they sent the November 3rd issue to print with the headline "Dewey Defeats Truman" — and then Harry S. Truman emerged victorious.
